24*7 Tank Sterilization : UV LED prevents the Bio-film formation. Maintains hygiene of water and stainless steel tank
Mineral Fortification : It corrects the pH of purified water
iProtect Purification Monitoring : Constantly monitors the purification process, and ensures safe water
LED Display with Smart Alerts : (a) Power (b) Purification process (c) Tank full (d) Filter life
